data-share-in-place.title: In-place sharing has no Data Share charge
data-share-in-place.body: This estimate pays for dataset snapshots and snapshot execution. Microsoft says in-place sharing does not incur a snapshot charge, so if the data stores involved support in-place sharing, that route avoids these two charges.

citation.quote: In-place sharing does not incur a snapshot charge.

data-share-incremental-snapshots.title: Incremental snapshots copy only new or changed files
data-share-incremental-snapshots.body: This estimate has a lot of snapshot execution time. Microsoft says an incremental snapshot copies only new or updated files, so for storage-based shares check that the snapshots are incremental rather than full copies; that shortens the execution time you pay for.

citation.source: Share and receive data from Azure Blob Storage and Azure Data Lake Storage
citation.quote: An incremental snapshot copies only new or updated files, based on the last modified time of the files.
